segments.cardSub: One presenter, one voice, eight ways to show what is said. Made to work with the sound off.
The whole line stays; each word fills with colour as it is spoken.
Big and centred: easy on a phone, but you cannot read ahead.
Three words at a time; the spoken word is larger.
Two lines, as on television; the older line moves up and away.
The whole paragraph is visible, so you can read ahead.
Each phrase comes from the presenter, typed out with the voice.
Important words are big; small words stay quiet.
One phrase in the bar; everything already said in a column.
